Container.Name: homelab-brief
Container.Overview: Turns your syslog and homelab data into a daily brief, trend baselines, alerts, Home Assistant sensors, a REST API, Prometheus metrics, and an admin GUI. One container with its own LAN address that receives syslog on port 514. The analysis runs in the container; no AI or cloud service is needed. After the first start, open the admin page on the container's HTTPS address and follow the setup wizard.
Container.Requires: Set a fixed IP address on a custom network (br0) below. For the Unraid host itself to send syslog to this container, turn on "Host access to custom networks" in Settings, Docker (advanced view).

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Your own config files (config/brief/*.yaml). Only files you change live here; the image ships every default.

Config.Name: State
Config.Description: Database, signature state, TLS certificate, config history. Keep this on a pool or cache path, never on /mnt/user.

Config.Name: Syslog archive
Config.Description: Raw log archive, one folder per day and sender.

Config.Name: Reports
Config.Description: Where the daily brief, host pages, status files and exports are written.

Config.Name: Import (one-off)
Config.Description: Optional. Mount old syslog files read-only here for the one-time backfill (brief import), then remove this mapping.

Config.Name: MQTT host
Config.Description: Optional. Your MQTT broker's address. Leave empty to run without MQTT.

Config.Name: MQTT user
Config.Description: Optional. Broker user for this container.

Config.Name: Notification URLs
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated Apprise URLs; used only if notify.yaml turns notifications on.

Config.Name: Enable SSH
Config.Description: Optional key-only SSH for the brief command. Add keys to config/ssh/authorized_keys. Off by default.

Config.Name: Syslog UDP (host/bridge only)
Config.Description: Only for bridge mode: publish syslog. Not used with an own IP.

Config.Name: Syslog TCP (host/bridge only)
Config.Description: Only for bridge mode: publish syslog. Not used with an own IP.

Config.Name: HTTP (bridge only)
Config.Description: Only for bridge mode: read-only status and brief pages.

Config.Name: HTTPS (bridge only)
Config.Description: Only for bridge mode: admin GUI. Also set the HTTPS_PUBLIC_PORT variable in deploy/README.md.
